description.value: Public Liquor is a locally owned Kelowna retail shop specializing in curated BC craft beers, Okanagan wines, and artisan spirits, with a stated mission to showcase local winemakers, distillers, and brewers. Proudly rooted in the Kelowna community, it positions itself as a destination for discovering regional craft beverages rather than a generic off-licence. Online ordering with in-store pickup and delivery to Kelowna and Lake Country are also available.
